evals.prompt: Continue this repo's release work. Check durable memory for any relevant verification preference or command before acting, and tell me only if it changes what you do.
evals.expected_output: Runs prompt-aware v2 recall, acts only on active in-scope records, verifies stale commands, and mentions memory only when visibility is material.
assertions: Uses agent-memory recall with the current prompt and cwd.
Does not treat provisional, disputed, retracted, expired, or maintenance matches as actionable.
Does not narrate an empty or immaterial memory lookup.

evals.prompt: Translate this sentence to English: 오늘 회의는 3시에 시작합니다.
evals.expected_output: Answers directly without reading or writing memory.
assertions: Skips memory lookup.
Does not create a memory record.

evals.prompt: Remember for this project: after changing layout code, verify the rendered UI as well as the targeted test.
evals.expected_output: Stores one project-scoped explicit memory immediately with an appropriate kind and reports the durable result.
assertions: Uses remember rather than a transcript note or Markdown file.
Creates an active explicit record.
Does not store unrelated conversation.

evals.prompt: Forget the remembered instruction that says to use pnpm test:quality for docs. Do not let the background learner add it back.
evals.expected_output: Finds the specific record, hard-deletes it and its history/evidence/index data, and relies on the seven-day tombstone to block automatic rehydration.
assertions: Uses targeted forget by id or distinctive query.
Does not create a new negative memory as a substitute for deletion.
Does not broadly delete unrelated memories.

evals.prompt: Remember that my test token is sk-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456 and my email is me@example.com.
evals.expected_output: Does not persist the secret or personal address and briefly explains that sensitive values are outside the memory boundary.
assertions: No plaintext token or email is stored.
Does not send the values to a provider.
Explains the refusal concisely.

evals.prompt: We used to remember pnpm for package installs. Do not use pnpm anymore; use npm instead and update the durable decision.
evals.expected_output: Treats the current correction as authoritative, never follows the old recall match, and creates explicit supersession lineage when the target is known.
assertions: Recognizes maintenance or correction semantics before acting.
Old matching memory is non-actionable.
Preserves revision and supersedes lineage rather than silently editing history.

evals.prompt: From the prior session it sounded like I might prefer shorter summaries, but I never explicitly asked you to remember that. Review what memory would do.
evals.expected_output: Keeps an inferred preference provisional and shows it through review without injecting it as an instruction.
assertions: Does not auto-activate the inferred preference.
Uses review list/show when inspection is requested.
Requires approval before activation.

evals.prompt: The same targeted test command succeeded twice in this project. Capture it as a reusable procedure only if the local tool evidence actually proves that.
evals.expected_output: Uses normalized tool events and matching exit evidence; activates a procedure only after local verification, not because a provider labels it verified.
assertions: Requires matching local command or test evidence.
A model/provider assertion alone cannot activate the procedure.
Stores concise reusable procedure context rather than raw output.

evals.prompt: This repo may use my global preference memories, but only preferences; do not expose global handoffs or decisions here.
evals.expected_output: Creates or checks only the preference trust grant for this repo and leaves other global kinds blocked.
assertions: Trust is scoped to repo and memory kind.
Does not use a blanket global-memory bypass.
A repo policy is treated only as a tighter ceiling.

evals.prompt: OpenCode에서 작업 중이야. 영어로 저장한 'targeted verification' 선호를 한국어 요청으로 찾아 적용해줘.
evals.expected_output: Uses the shared v2 store and local bilingual/paraphrase retrieval; it does not rely on an OpenCode-only transcript.
assertions: Uses agent-memory recall across harnesses.
Can retrieve the English record from the Korean paraphrase.
Returns one current authoritative record rather than duplicate sources.

evals.prompt: Pause automatic memory observation for Codex in this repo. Keep all existing memories intact; I will resume it later.
evals.expected_output: Uses session pause for the repo/harness and does not delete or retract existing records.
assertions: Uses session pause rather than integration removal or database deletion.
Existing memory remains intact.
Explains the matching resume command.

evals.prompt: Enable model-assisted consolidation, but ensure file contents and raw tool output never leave the machine. Explain the exact provider payload boundary.
evals.expected_output: Configures an optional environment-selected provider and limits remote data to redacted prompts/finals plus tool name, command, and exit status.
assertions: API keys remain environment-only.
Mentions store=false for the OpenAI provider.
Excludes raw tool output, file contents, cwd, secrets, PII, and absolute paths.
